messages:
kayla-sales: Hey team -- customer on Dedicated POC hitting parsing failures when they chain 2 tool calls in one conversation. They say outputs sometimes merge and JSON mode fails. Example error: `JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)`

raj-eng: Can you paste the request ids + raw response? Also which model/version and whether they're streaming?

kayla-sales: Request IDs: `req_8f3b2a` and `req_8f3b2b`. Model: rwd-compat-7b-v3, mode: json_mode=true, stream=true. They gave a truncated snippet:

```
{"toolA_output": "{\"items\": [1,2,",
"toolB_output": "\"note\": \"started\"}\n"}
```

And the client log shows a 429 happening mid-stream: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` then a partial chunk.

sam-ml: Streaming + multiple tool invocations can interleave chunk boundaries. If the client expects a single JSON blob, streaming needs careful framing. Two options: disable streaming for fncall sequences, or have the runtime emit a complete tool-result envelope per tool (e.g., `--end-of-tool--`).

raj-eng: Can you also share the server-side trace id? If we search logs we can see whether the runtime merged two tool outputs into one stream buffer.

kayla-sales: trace: `trace-2026-03-19-9a7c`. Pasted their client payload (sanitized):

```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "rwd-compat-7b-v3",
  "tools": ["price_lookup","inventory_check"],
  "json_mode": true,
  "stream": true,
  "input": "Find price and availability for SKU: 12345"
}
```

deploy-bot: rate-limiter: notice for customer-cust-42 - x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 0, reset_in: 12s

raj-eng: OK seeing matching traces. The runtime returned `HTTP/1.1 200` with chunked transfer, but theres an intervening 429 for second tool due to per-tool QPS counting. That explains the truncated JSON.

sam-ml: Two quick mitigation steps: 1) recommend setting `stream=false` for the POC toolchain so the client receives complete JSON per call; 2) if streaming is required, ensure each tool call is its own high-level message (i.e., call tool A, wait for closure token, then call tool B). We'll provide a snippet for the SDK.

liz-se: Security/customer asked about data residency and whether tool outputs touch shared caches. Customer wants a QSA note before we demo the fix. We need to confirm Dedicated isolation & KMS handling of intermediate tool results.

raj-eng: I'll check runtime logs for whether cache persisted tool outputs. If any KV cache was used its ephemeral per-request unless "persist_tool_results" is enabled (default false).

kayla-sales: Customer also mentioned odd characters showing up (`\uFFFD`) and occasional BOM markers at start of tool output. Could that be encoding mismatch?

sam-ml: BOM can happen if a tool calls an external 3rd-party API that returns `UTF-8-BOM`. Our parser treats responses as UTF-8 without BOM. We can strip BOM on ingest; quick patch: in SDK inner loop `if payload.bytes.startsWith(b"\xEF\xBB\xBF") stripFirst3()`. Will prepare a tiny hotfix for Dedicated customers.

raj-eng: For immediate unblock: tell customer to set `stream=false` and use sequential tool calls. I'll also open an internal bug to harden streaming framing.

kayla-sales: I'll relay: 1) temp workaround (stream=false / sequential tool calls), 2) ops will watch their quota and raise Dedicated QPS if needed, 3) were prepping a BOM-strip patch and a runtime framing fix. Customer asked for ETA on patch.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: hotfix/strip-bom -> staging (job 2435) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

raj-eng: ETA for hotfix to staging ~ 3h, can push to dedicated canary later today if staging looks good.

liz-se: For QSA: I'll draft an email noting Dedicated isolation, non-persistent caches by default, and KMS key ownership options. Need a contact in sales to approve wording.

kayla-sales: Thanks all — I'll send the workaround now and schedule a call with the customer for 11:30 PT. Marking this thread for solutions-eng handoff. :white_check_mark:
